note: WORLDSEED is capture-class: the itch.io HTML5 embed served from https://html-classic.itch.zone/html/19693588/ — a SINGLE self-contained index.html (1970079 B) whose whole game is inline. §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — no public upstream repo exists (the itch page carries no repo link, and a GitHub search finds nothing for the game or the author slug Generic-King), so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, rendered to fixpoint (format until the output stops changing, max 5 passes) — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/index-inline-N.pretty.{js,css} per inline block (every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<tag>-NN.js of the two inline script blocks: the classic script is one `(() => { … })();` IIFE wrapping the author's ~71 source modules (each introduced by a `// ---- world/x.js ----` banner), so slices cut the IIFE BODY at top-level declaration boundaries in ~250-350 line windows (oversized single declarations stay whole) with the exact 2-line provenance header; the IIFE wrapper head (opening + 'use strict' + first module banner) is a wholeFile section and the `})();` closer a skipped section, both indexed and never sliced. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. No vendor bytes exist in the capture to whole-file: three.js 0.186.1 is an EXTERNAL CDN ES-module import (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.186.1/three.module.min.js) and the fonts stylesheet an external CDN link — CDN dependencies stay CDN (fleet rule; socker precedent 2026-10-10), recorded in notRendered and README.md; the game degrades gracefully without both. Identifiers in src/ are the author's own names (the inline source is commented and human-written — no rename campaign needed). Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
